rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong Cantonese term for a daughter-in-law.

example.english: My daughter-in-law is really good at cooking.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 san1 pou5 zyu2 faan6 hou2 lek1

rows.note: Use this as a more formal or written synonym when 新抱 is not preferred.

example.english: She is the Li family's daughter-in-law.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 lei5 gaa1 ge3 sik1 fu5

rows.note: This is an older written synonym, mainly encountered in formal or literary contexts.

example.english: The marriage document states the daughter-in-law's name.
example.jyutping: fan1 syu1 soeng6 se2 ming4 san1 pou5 sing3 ming4
